authors: Stone GN, Raine NE, Prescott M, Willmer PG
title: Pollination ecology of acacias (Fabaceae, Mimosoideae)
why: Review of floral rewards and flowering timing in acacias; the abstract (opened) says the non-Phyllodineae subgenera have single-day flowers with clear daily patterns. The review may tabulate hours of anthesis for Acacia karroo and A. farnesiana (now Vachellia), which would close plant diel.

why: Title (harvest output, query "Poa anthesis") names Poa annua anthesis under light and temperature; it may give the hours of day at which florets open. My WebFetch of the abstract page went unanswered. Closes plant diel for Poa annua if it reports hours.
